prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

A system for displaying a product is disclosed. The system includes a wall having a recess therein and a display structure that defines the recess. The display structure extends through a front surface of the wall and includes a frame having a top panel, a bottom panel, and two side panels. The top and bottom panels are longer than the side panels. The system further includes a plurality of modular display units disposed within the display structure. Each modular display unit extends from the bottom panel to the top panel. At least a first one of the modular display units includes a frame open to a front exterior of the display structure and at least a second one of the modular display units is not open to the front exterior of the display structure. The system further includes a plurality of display elements disposed within the plurality of display units.

outputs.L1: A system for displaying a product is disclosed. The system includes a wall having a recess formed therein and a display structure defining the recess. The display structure extends through a front surface of the wall and includes a frame comprising a top panel, a bottom panel, and two side panels. The top and bottom panels are longer than the side panels. The system further includes a plurality of modular display units disposed within the display structure, each modular display unit extending from the bottom panel to the top panel. At least a first modular display unit includes a frame that is open to a front exterior of the display structure, and at least a second modular display unit is not open to the front exterior of the display structure. The system further includes a plurality of display elements disposed within the plurality of display units.
outputs.L2: Disclosed is a product presentation system. The system comprises a wall with an inset area, along with a display assembly that forms that inset area. The display assembly passes through the wall’s front face and has a frame made up of an upper panel, a lower panel, and a pair of side panels. The upper and lower panels have a greater length than the side panels. The system also comprises multiple modular display units positioned inside the display assembly. Each modular display unit spans between the lower panel and the upper panel. At least one first modular display unit has a frame that is open toward the front outside of the display assembly, while at least one second modular display unit is closed with respect to the front outside of the display assembly. The system additionally includes multiple display components arranged within the modular display units.
outputs.L3:
The system includes a wall having a recess formed by a display structure. The display structure extends through a front surface of the wall and is configured to define the recessed area within the wall.

The display structure includes a frame having a top panel, a bottom panel, and opposing side panels. The top and bottom panels extend laterally across the recess and are longer than the side panels, which extend between the top and bottom panels.

A plurality of modular display units are positioned within the display structure. Each modular display unit extends vertically from the bottom panel to the top panel of the frame. The modular display units are arranged within the recess and are configured to support or contain one or more display elements.

At least one of the modular display units is open toward the front exterior of the wall, allowing its display element or elements to be viewed or accessed from the front. At least one other modular display unit is not open toward the front exterior, thereby providing a different display, storage, enclosure, or presentation configuration within the same display structure.
outputs.L4:
A recessed wall-mounted product display system is designed to present merchandise in an organized, attractive, and space-efficient manner within a recess formed in a wall. The system includes a display structure having a surrounding frame that fits into or around the wall recess, creating a clean built-in appearance. The display structure includes a bottom panel, a top panel, and side portions that define an interior display area. Within this area, multiple modular display units extend generally between the bottom panel and the top panel, allowing the display space to be divided into separate vertical sections for different products or product categories.

The modular display units may be arranged in a variety of configurations depending on the intended use of the display. Some of the modular display units are front-open units, meaning that they are accessible from the front of the display structure. These front-open units may include shelves, trays, hooks, racks, compartments, or other display elements that allow products to be placed, removed, or viewed directly by a customer or user. Other modular display units are non-front-open units, which may be enclosed, partially enclosed, covered, or configured to display products or branding elements without direct front access. These units may include panels, product holders, illuminated display surfaces, graphic areas, sample mounts, or other fixed or protected display elements.

By combining front-open and non-front-open modular units within the same recessed display structure, the system provides flexibility for presenting a wide range of products. Items that need to be handled or frequently restocked can be placed in front-open units, while featured products, promotional materials, decorative panels, or protected merchandise can be positioned in non-front-open units. The modular nature of the display units allows the arrangement to be customized, replaced, or reconfigured as product lines change.

The recessed installation helps conserve floor space while giving the display a streamlined architectural appearance. The frame defines the visible border of the system and can help conceal the edges of the wall recess, the modular units, or any mounting components. As a result, the system provides a neat and integrated presentation suitable for retail stores, showrooms, service areas, or other commercial environments where products must be displayed clearly and efficiently. Overall, the product display system combines a built-in wall-mounted structure with interchangeable display modules to create a versatile, organized, and visually appealing product presentation.

The word “the” points to something specific: the place, the moment, the idea, the person. It gives language focus and helps us understand exactly what is being discussed.

Each word in a sentence has its own purpose. Each detail can add meaning, rhythm, or clarity. When we choose words carefully, even simple ones like “the” and “each” can make writing stronger. The smallest words often do the quietest but most important work.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for a retail product display system built into a recessed wall, with a rectangular frame, modular vertical display units, and display elements inside the units.
counterfactuals.output: A retail product display system is configured for installation within a recessed wall opening. The system includes a substantially rectangular frame sized to be received within the recessed opening and defining an interior display region. A plurality of modular vertical display units are removably or adjustably positioned within the frame, each vertical display unit extending generally between upper and lower portions of the frame. One or more display elements are disposed within each vertical display unit and are configured to support, retain, illuminate, identify, or otherwise present retail products to consumers. The modular vertical display units may be rearranged, replaced, or configured with different display elements to accommodate varying product types, merchandising arrangements, and aesthetic requirements. The system provides an integrated wall-mounted retail display having a customizable modular structure while maintaining a recessed, space-efficient presentation.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.output: A system for displaying a product is disclosed, comprising a recessed wall display configured to be received at least partially within a wall cavity and including a plurality of interchangeable modular display units arranged within a support frame, the plurality of modular display units including at least one open-front unit defining an accessible display compartment for presenting a product and at least one non-open-front unit having a closed, covered, glazed, or otherwise obstructed front surface for concealing, protecting, illuminating, storing, or supporting a product or display component. The modular display units may be removably secured to the support frame in selectable positions to permit reconfiguration of the display, replacement of individual units, and formation of varied display layouts while maintaining a generally flush or recessed appearance relative to a surrounding wall surface.

counterfactuals.output:

a wall having a front surface and an opening extending through the front surface;

a display structure extending at least partially through the opening of the wall, the display structure including a frame positioned adjacent the front surface of the wall and defining a recess; and

a plurality of modular product display units received in the recess and supported by the display structure, each modular product display unit being configured to display at least one product and being selectively removable from the recess independently of at least one other modular product display unit.
